Christmas Markets in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 3 events

Christmas markets, winter fairs and festive pop-ups in Amsterdam, from big outdoor markets to small indoor makers' fairs. They suit families, friends looking for a cosy evening and anyone hunting for gifts that don't come from a chain store. This page is this week's slice; for the whole season, see Christmas in Amsterdam, 2026–27. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

  1. Winter Market Leidseplein

    Christmas Markets · Markets · Food · Drink

    When
    13 Nov 2026 – 3 Jan 2027 (daily), Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00; Sat & Sun 11:00–23:00
    Where
    Leidseplein & Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen, Amsterdam (Leidseplein, Centrum)
    Price
    Free entry; pay per stall
    Organiser
    IJsbaan Amsterdam

    Wooden chalets on Leidseplein and the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen selling Christmas decorations, gifts, cheese, oliebollen and hot snacks, with a mulled-wine tower and a big Christmas tree. Runs until 3 January.

    Details and tickets for Winter Market Leidseplein (organiser's site)

  2. The Creative Lab — Holiday Gift Shop

    Pop-up Shops · Christmas Markets · Fashion & Vintage

    When
    Fri 20 Nov – Sun 20 Dec, Tue–Sun 11:30–18:30 (closed Mon)
    Where
    De Hallen (Beeldend Gesproken), Hannie Dankbaarpassage 25, Amsterdam (Oud-West)
    Price
    Free entry
    Organiser
    The Creative Lab

    The Creative Lab's festive pop-up shop is back in De Hallen, with a rotating line-up of independent makers, vintage sellers and jewellers changing every week until Christmas.

    Details and tickets for The Creative Lab — Holiday Gift Shop (organiser's site)

  3. Sunday Market Oostenburg — winter edition

    Christmas Markets · Markets · Food

    When
    Sun 22 Nov, 11:00–17:00
    Where
    Oostenburgermiddenstraat, Amsterdam (Oostenburg)
    Price
    Free
    Organiser
    Sunday Market

    A one-off wintry pop-up of the Sunday Market on the Oostenburg island — makers, designers and foodies gearing up for the festive season.
